charts.title: Kepler-138 b: orbits around Kepler-138
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-138's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-138 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Morton et al. 2016 (2016ApJ...822...86M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MORTON_ET_AL__2016): P 10.31320643 d
